title: Canonical relative Proj isomorphism induced by a graded algebra isomorphism
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $A,B$ be quasi-coherent graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebras in the affine-basis presentation [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra]. For a base-linear graded algebra isomorphism $e:A\simeq B$, define its induced contravariant relative Proj isomorphism $\operatorname{Proj}_X(B)\simeq\operatorname{Proj}_X(A)$ [def-nagata-relative-proj] by the usual homogeneous localization maps. On an affine base open and a homogeneous $a\in A_d$, $d>0$, its comorphism sends each fraction $b/a^m$ of degree zero to $e(b)/e(a)^m$; the inverse is constructed using $e^{-1}$. The maps glue over standard opens and affine base restrictions. This is the specified canonical isomorphism, with no surjectivity hypothesis beyond $e$ being an isomorphism and no identification $A_0=\mathcal O_X$ required.
